en: A vintage black-and-white postcard view of a large, grand hotel building in a neoclassical style with tall columns and multiple stories. In front of the hotel there is a broad terrace filled with tables and people seated outdoors, bordered by decorative balustrades and staircases leading down to a wide open square or street, where pedestrians are walking. Ornate street lamps line the area. The upper left corner of the postcard bears the printed caption 'Hotel Esplanade, Zagreb'.
